question: A thin wire with uniform linear charge density $+λ$ is bent into a circular arc of radius $R$ that subtends an angle of $5π/3$ at its center, $C$. A point charge $+Q$ is fixed at $C$. A second point charge, $-Q$, is fixed at the midpoint of the chord that closes the arc's gap. What is the magnitude of the net electrostatic force on the charge $+Q$ at the center?
